# SessionResumptionConfig

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [SessionResumptionConfig](index.html)(val handle: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val transparent: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null)

Configures the session resumption mechanism.

Setting this asks the server to send session resumption updates over the connection.
